description: Historical KC ids -> current ids. The first tensor lessons (np-1..np-3) were authored as NumPy and converted to the PyTorch dialect in 2026-08; their KC ids kept the `numpy.` prefix until 2026-09-18, which made a learner drilling torch.arange read reports about 'NumPy problems'. The backend applies this map when it loads a learner's saved state or attempt log, so old saves keep their ladder, posteriors and exposure. Append-only: never remove an entry while any user file on Fly could still carry the old id.
